name: T lymphocyte
failures: Exhaustion, autoreactivity, immunodeficiency, malignancy, age-related repertoire narrowing.

see.note: Flow cytometry and repertoire sequencing from a blood draw.

model.note: A healthy repertoire is describable statistically, not specified precisely.

reach.note: Ex vivo engineering is routine; in vivo CAR generation is early-stage.

verify.note: Persistence and expansion tracked directly in blood.

anchors: In vivo CAR-T programmes, preclinical to Phase 1
